credits.overview: Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

credits.overview: Ananya goes boar hunting with his cousin Giri and a mute plantation worker, Kaada. They accidentally kill a tiger and decide to smuggle its claws and skin.
